entities.name: Ohran Mountains
entities.description: A large mountainous region in central Gulmany, part of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria, formerly the Colekgan Mountains.

entities.name: Gulmany
entities.description: An island of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Terisian Isles lie.

entities.name: Ohran Ridge
entities.description: The southwestern spur of the mountains, the only accessible part during the Ice Age; Urza and Xantcha made a home there.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The age that locked the Colekgan Mountains heavily in ice.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: The period after the Ice Age, after which the Colekgans took the name Ohran Mountains.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: A flood that displaced the homes and towns of western Terisiare.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: A school whose wizards and sages helped evacuate, rescue and resettle flood victims.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Made a home in the Ohran Ridge with Xantcha, then relocated to Tolaria to found the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Lived with Urza in the Ohran Ridge until her death in Koilos.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island where Urza relocated to found the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy founded by Urza on Tolaria.

events.summary: Wizards and sages of the School of the Unseen travel across western Terisiare as far north as the Ohran Mountains, evacuating and resettling flood victims.
events.quote: they helped evacuate, rescue, and resettle those whose homes and towns were lost to the floods

events.summary: Urza and Xantcha make a home in the Ohran Ridge until Xantcha dies in Koilos and Urza goes to Tolaria to found the Tolarian Academy.
events.quote: Urza and Xantcha made a home for themselves in the Ohran Ridge

relations.note: The range is in central Gulmany.
relations.quote: a large mountainous region in central Gulmany

relations.note: They shared a home in the Ohran Ridge.
relations.quote: Urza and Xantcha made a home for themselves in the Ohran Ridge
